course.title: Public and Local Government Finance
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Draw the supply and demand curve for cookies. If the government imposes a tax on (20) cookies, show what happens to the quantity sold, the price paid by buyers and the price paid by sellers. In your diagram, show the deadweight loss from the tax. Explain the meaning of deadweight loss.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
